title: ARCADE: WALK-OVER LOOT
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 11 of 20. In the arcade a box in reach that still holds loot is searched with no key, so a walk-up player loots by walking over it, and the bar fills six times as fast (also for a box player 2 searches through the host). A valuable never goes into the backpack: it scores a tenth of its value at once and the same goes into the haul pot that an extraction pays again, shown as +N on its pickup row. Ammo, heals, throws, plates and keys go where they always went. A pile the player dropped, a box a teammate holds and a hired man are never searched by walking over them. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade walking over a box loots it fast, and valuables become points and pot instead of backpack weight.
